messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we're planning to turn on the v1 deprecation banner next Wed and soft-redirect model aliases the week after. Need owners for all code snippets + a clear rollback playbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1578

Dylan: I'll own Node + Python snippets. Will open a PR today to update the examples and add notes about changed param names.

Adele: I'll take model swap examples (embeddings + responses). I'll add a short migration table for vector dims and a fallback pattern.

Kevin: Quick Q — are we doing a 302 or 301 for alias redirects? That affects client guidance.

Maya: We're doing 302 (temporary) for two weeks with a deprecation warning in the response header, then 301 after the grace period. Docs should show: recommended v2 snippet, then a fallback alias example.

Dylan: copying the snippet pattern here:
```
# recommended
client.responses.create({ model: "rwd-4o", input: "Summarize the doc." })

# fallback for old installs
client.responses.create({ model: "rwd-embed-v1-alias", input: "Summarize the doc.", warn: true })
```

Adele: I'll include a brief test snippet to assert embedding dims before writing vectors.

Chris: I'll add a CI smoke test job under docs-checks that runs the snippets against a staging endpoint. Ping me if you need the test vector.

Dylan: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1580 (node/python snippet updates)

Adele: I'll also add a rollback section with steps: revert docs PR, remove banner, trigger emergency redirect to stable model. Drafting now.

Docs-bot: PR 1578 comment: "needs review from docs-team" :memo:

Maya: Can we aim to merge everything by EOD Friday so we can do the banner soft-launch Monday? @Kevin please confirm release window.

Kevin: Confirmed. Ops scheduled maintenance window Mon 10:00-12:00 UTC. If we need rollback after soft-launch, we'll use the hotfix channel.

Dylan: sounds good. I'll tag snippet owners in the PRs.

Adele: leaving a checklist on the PR for model authors and QA.

Maya: Thanks team — callouts: (1) add inline note about `embed_dim` mismatch, (2) include quick rollback commands, (3) update migration FAQ. I'll run a docs review on Friday.

Chris: I'll own the smoke test PR and set up alerts on failures.

Maya: closing loop — once snippets merged I'll coordinate the banner publish and notify support for customer comms. :rocket:
